threads.body: [General] This resolves `unwrap` reflectively every time a connection wrapper misses the virtual-field cache, including repeatedly caching the same lookup failure for classes without `unwrap`. Repository guidance requires runtime-class-dependent reflection (and missing methods) to be cached with `ClassValue` (`.github/agents/knowledge/java-reflection.md:11-17`); please cache this method lookup so connection/query paths do not repeatedly call `Class.getMethod`.

replies.body:
Addressed in 8ba5d496fa96d02d7cbb454cc24e88d954263b35.

Analysis: `cacheConnectionInfo` and `getConnectionInfo` can inspect instances of the same runtime class repeatedly. A `ClassValue<Method>` resolves `unwrap` once per class and caches `null` when the method is absent, while `Method.invoke` preserves the existing failure behavior.

Upsides: Avoids repeated `Class.getMethod` calls on connection and query paths, including repeated failed lookups, without retaining application classes.

Downsides: Adds one class-scoped cache entry per encountered runtime class.

threads.body: [General] This installs a cleared context scope before the rest of `start()` performs fallible work (argument inspection, virtual-field access, and `instrumenter().start()`). If any of that throws, the enter advice suppresses the exception and returns its default state, so exit cannot close this scope or decrement the call depth; the thread then remains under the wrong context and subsequent queries can stay suppressed. Please ensure the scope and call depth are cleaned up on every exceptional path, or defer `makeCurrent()` until the last fallible action before returning.
